Bench: P.Sree Sudha
The Honourable Smt. Justice P.Sree Sudha
 M.A.C.M.A.No.3253 of 2008
J U D G M E N T:

This Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act,
1988 against the Judgment and Decree dated 17.03.2006 passed in O.P.No.1656 of 2002 passed by the learned Chairman, Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-II Additional District Judge (FTC), Nizamabad.

entities.text: Motor Vehicles Accidents Claims Tribunal-cum-II Additional District Judge (FTC), Nizamabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 02. The appellant/petitioner filed O.P.No.1656 of 2002, claiming compensation of Rs.1,00,000/- for injuries sustained by him in the road traffic accident occurred on 11.10.2002.
The trial Court after considering the arguments of both sides, granted compensation of Rs.10,000/-.
Aggrieved by the said Judgment, petitioner therein preferred the present appeal.
There is no dispute regarding the accident, but the quantum of the compensation is only disputed, this Court is no going into other details.
03. The petitioner himself was examined as PW1 and filed Ex.A3 wound certificate issued by the Government Medical Officer, Nizamabad.

As per Ex.A3 wound certificate sustained one contusion on left foot and treated in the hospital from 11.10.2002 to 13.10.2002 and also filed medical bills,
prescriptions and X-ray films etc.,.
04. Admittedly, appellant/petitioner sustained one contusion on left foot, as such it is reasonable to award Rs.10,000/- for injury.

Apart from that he is also entitled for an amount of Rs.5,000/- for pain and suffering and Rs.5,000/- towards loss of amenities and he is also entitled for Rs.5,000/-
towards medical expenses, Rs.5,000/- towards transportation charges and Rs.5,000/- towards extra nourishment.

05. Therefore, the appellant/petitioner is entitled for the compensation in the following terms:
1. Injury @ Rs.10,000/- Rs.10,000/-
2. Pain and Suffering Rs.5,000/-
3. Loss of Amenities Rs.5,000/-

sentences.text:
1 4. Medical Expenses Rs.5,000/-
5. Transportation Charges Rs.5,000/-
6. Extra nourishment Rs.5,000/-
 TOTAL Rs.35,000/-
 06.

In the result, the Motor Accident Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount from Rs.10,000/- to Rs.35,000/-
(Rupees Thirty Five Thousand only) with interest at the rate of 7.5% per annum from the date of filing the petition till date of realization.

Respondent Nos.1 and 2 are jointly and severally liable to pay the compensation amount and Respondent No.2/Insurance Company shall deposit the entire amount within a period of one month from the date of receipt of a copy of this Judgment.
On such deposit, the appellant is entitled to withdraw the said amount along with interest accrued thereon.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
